name: Six Traceable Requirements
description: Ensures the local case contains six sourced feature proposals.
testCode:
import main
assert len(main.REQUIREMENTS)==6
assert len({x['id'] for x in main.REQUIREMENTS})==6
assert all(x['source'] and x['ratings'] for x in main.REQUIREMENTS)

name: Spotify Playlist State Constraint
description: Rejects public AND collaborative on the same playlist; permits other states.
testCode:
import main
assert not main.playlist_policy_ok(True,True), 'Spotify D1 forbids both flags true.'
assert main.playlist_policy_ok(True,False)
assert main.playlist_policy_ok(False,True)
assert main.playlist_policy_ok(False,False)

name: Stakeholder-Weighted Utility
description: Confirms all three stakeholder ratings contribute according to the supplied weights.
testCode:
import main
assert abs(sum(main.STAKEHOLDER_WEIGHTS.values())-1.0)<1e-9
for x in main.REQUIREMENTS:
    expected=sum(main.STAKEHOLDER_WEIGHTS[k]*x['ratings'][k] for k in main.STAKEHOLDER_WEIGHTS)
    assert abs(main.requirement_utility(x)-expected)<1e-9, f"Incorrect utility for {x['id']}"

name: Release Budget and Dependencies
description: Verifies the optimizer respects effort limits, explicit prerequisites and the documented playlist-state rule.
testCode:
import main
selected=main.select_release()
assert main.BUDGET_DAYS==8, 'Restore the original 8-day budget after the what-if experiment.'
assert main.feasible_release(selected)
assert sum(x['days'] for x in selected)<=main.BUDGET_DAYS
ids={x['id'] for x in selected}
assert 'FR-06' not in ids
for row in selected:
    assert set(row['requires']).issubset(ids)

name: AI Recommendation Guardrail
description: Checks that the audit identifies a prohibited AI recommendation and unknown requirement.
testCode:
import main
issues=main.audit_ai_order(['FR-06','FR-99'])
assert any('FR-06' in issue for issue in issues)
assert any('FR-99' in issue for issue in issues)
assert main.audit_ai_order(['FR-01','FR-03'])==[]
